flashcard_questions.q: What is a functional group in an organic molecule?
flashcard_questions.a: The atom or group of atoms that determines the chemical properties of the molecule.

flashcard_questions.q: Which functional group defines the alkene homologous series?
What is the general formula of the alkene series?
The simplest alkene is ____, which has the formula ____.
Why are alkanes described as saturated hydrocarbons?
flashcard_questions.a: They contain only single C–C bonds.

flashcard_questions.q: What colour change shows a positive bromine water test for an alkene?
Which catalyst is used to add hydrogen across the double bond of an alkene?
What is the functional group of the alcohols?
Complete the word equation: ethene + steam → ____
In fermentation, yeast breaks down sugars into ethanol and which gas?
What is the functional group of the carboxylic acids?
Which carboxylic acid is found in vinegar?
Why do carboxylic acids form only weakly acidic solutions?
flashcard_questions.a: They ionise only partially, so few H⁺ ions are released.

flashcard_questions.q: What forms when a carboxylic acid reacts with an alcohol using an acid catalyst?
(Higher) What does it mean to call hydrochloric acid a strong acid?
flashcard_questions.a: It ionises completely in water, so every molecule releases H⁺ ions.
